turns.reply: Header models with the default `convert_underscores=True` no longer accept raw underscore header names like `x_token`; only `x-token` matches. The fix is in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py`: when underscore conversion applies, the field's underscore name is added to `processed_keys`, so the leftover-header pass no longer forwards it. With `convert_underscores=False`, underscore headers are still accepted. I checked this with a small script and ran the header-params tutorial tests (26 passed); I did not add a new test.
